newsitem.title: USA: Corestaff sets acquisition, sees EPS boost.
newsitem.headline: Corestaff sets acquisition, sees EPS boost.

text.p: Corestaff Inc said Friday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Business Management Data Inc and its India-based affiliate, and said the buy would add $0.03 to its 1997 earnings per share.

Business Management Data, a computer code maintenance and year 2000 conversion company, and India-based Sriven Computer Solutions Inc will have combined revenues in excess of $30 million in 1997, Corestaff said.
The acquisition, which is subject to certain governmental approvals, is expected to close in the second quarter, it said.
